006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IModuleNodeItem;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IModelElementVisitor;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
011
012import java.util.Collection;
013
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015
016/**
017 * A set of constraints targeted at the contents of a Metaschema module.
018 */
019public interface IConstraintSet {
020  /**
021   * Get information about where the constraint set was sourced from.
022   *
023   * @return the source information
024   */
025  @NonNull
026  ISource getSource();
027
028  /**
029   * Get constraint sets imported by this constraint set.
030   *
031   * @return the imported constraint sets
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  Collection<? extends IConstraintSet> getImportedConstraintSets();
035
036  /**
037   * Apply the constraints associated with this constraint set to the provided
038   * module, if applicable.
039   * <p>
040   * Callers of this method are required to track which definitions have been
041   * previously targeted based on the result of this method and to provide these
042   * to subsequent calls of this method targeting different modules. This approach
043   * ensures that a given constraint is not applied more than once.
044   *
045   * @param moduleItem
046   *          the module node item to apply applicable constraints to
047   * @param visitor
048   *          the visitor used to apply constraints to target definitions
049   */
050  void applyConstraintsForModule(
051      @NonNull IModuleNodeItem moduleItem,
052      @NonNull IModelElementVisitor<ITargetedConstraints, Void> visitor);
053}
